name: Analytical Convenience With M3str, Fjäll, Nocivo -Free Entry
description: This event features a lineup of techno artists including M3STR, Fjäll, and Nocivo. It takes place at Gare Porto and offers free entry.
longDescription:
Analytical Convenience presents a night of techno music at Gare Porto. The lineup includes M3STR performing live, alongside DJ sets from Fjäll and Nocivo. 

The event is scheduled for Saturday, November 21, starting at 11:00 PM and running until 6:00 AM. Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto.

Entry to this event is free. The music styles featured are techno, deep techno, Detroit techno, hypnotic techno, acid techno, and dub techno.
